snapshot.sourceInventory: git archive of pinned commit filtered to JS/TS source extensions

templatesExcluded.reason: Git-ignored generated templates; generated/checked separately by scripts/sync-template.ts and therefore absent from the source inventory.

startingSnapshot.parser: same readExceptions implementation applied to git archive of exact baseline commit
startingSnapshot.note: Unchanged fingerprints inherit provenance only. Removed or added/modified memberships are comparison categories, not review dispositions.

provenance.method: Conservative. Proven canonical/mirror provenance is not assigned in this snapshot. packages/registry/registry.ts item file targets are install destinations, frequently many-to-one (for example, multiple gateway items target ~/lib/ai/gateway.ts), not source-to-generated-copy declarations. demo-sync.ts installs selected registry items into a temporary demo and its demoSource transformation only special-cases lib/ai/gateway-model-defaults.ts; target equality and byte equality do not by themselves establish source provenance. Reclassify only when a selected generated output is directly mapped to its source.

mappingAudit.rejectedMethod: Joining registry item file.path to its target path as if each target were a generated mirror.

contentDifferentExamples.finding: False pair: the app file is the Vercel gateway while LiteLLM is one of several providers targeting the same install slot.
False pair: the app file is the Vercel Blob adapter while Yandex is one of several providers targeting the same install slot.

mappingAudit.impact: All previous registry-canonical-source, registry-generated-mirror, and known-chatjs-generated-subtree-unmapped labels are withdrawn. Membership counts and rule/path fingerprints are unaffected.

templateExclusion.reason: Git-ignored generated templates; generated/checked separately by scripts/sync-template.ts and absent from the committed source inventory.

currentScopeRecordShape: Files contain ordered directives; each directive contains one membership object per rule. `reasonPatternId` indexes the deduplicated reasonPatterns table. This keeps path, reason and provenance metadata normalized while preserving exact path/rule/directive-location/fingerprint membership identity.
